warnings.message: Schwab could not be read, so the accounts come from the local history, without values or hashes: [not_logged_in] There is no Schwab login at ~/.config/schwabtx/token.json (from config.json). Ask the user to run `schwabtx login` in their own terminal, then call again; do not run it yourself, it needs their browser. If schwabtx already works in their terminal, it keeps its login elsewhere: ask them to run `schwabtx setup` there, which saves the paths it uses, and to restart this server.
